messages:
maya: Hey team, quick triage — SOC2 auditor flagged a gap: we don't have a clear mapping of KMS/HSM key IDs to Dedicated clusters in the evidence pack. Who owns the key->cluster mapping for Dedicated?
jordan: I thought eng-infra owned the mapping, but the internal doc is vague. @owen any recollection? :thinking:
owen: I created the initial mapping in PR #4821 but it only covered Hosted. Dedicated uses envelope keys + a different keyring. PR didn't include the HSM attestation artifact (I planned a follow-up).
priya: Priya (security) — for SOC2 we need three artifacts: 1) list of key IDs per environment/cluster, 2) HSM attestation proof (where applicable), 3) an example from the ingest pipeline showing the key_id is logged. Auditor wants these by 2026-04-01. Who can take each piece?
alyssa: I can take the ingest/log side (logs team). We need a concrete query to pull proof that key_id is present. I can run it and export samples.
maya: Can you paste the exact query we should run so others can validate?
alyssa: Sure — example SQL for our clickhouse-style store: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE payload->'kms'->>'key_id' IS NOT NULL AND ts >= '2026-03-01';
``` Run with a LIMIT sample export to show a few rows.
jordan: Ops side: I can own the key-id listing per cluster — I'll pull from KeyMgmt service and assemble a doc. Assigning to myself, will target a draft by 2026-03-25.
compliance-bot: Automated reminder: SOC2 evidence due 2026-04-01. Checklist item added: "KMS key mapping - eng-security". See https://redwood.internal/compliance/checklists/SOC2 for details.
owen: Quick heads-up — PR #4821 needed a test fix; that was blocking generation of the attestation artifact. I'm re-running CI now.
priya: If CI isn't green by EOD, escalate fallback: we can provide a signed engineering attestation + screenshots of the key listing UI and console logs as interim evidence for fieldwork. Not ideal, but acceptable for initial audit review.
maya: Action items recap: jordan (key list doc by 2026-03-25), owen (fix/re-run PR and produce attestation artifact by EOD), alyssa (query + sample results by 2026-03-26), priya (prepare fallback attestation template). I'll compile the final evidence doc after those arrive. :thumbsup:
jordan: Noted. I'll create the doc and post link once initial pull is done: https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2/kms-key-list
owen: CI rerun finished — tests passed. I uploaded the attestation artifact: s3://redwood-audit-evidence/attestations/2026-03-17/attestation.json
alyssa: Ran the query, exported a 5-row sample (redacted) — one sample row: {"ts":"2026-03-16T12:10Z","kms":{"key_id":"env-prod-enc-1"}}. Uploaded sample to the doc.
priya: Thanks everyone. Maya, when you compile, please mark the checklist item as "evidence attached" and add links to the artifact + samples.
maya: Will do. Closing loop — ping here if anything else blocks the evidence pack.
